module: Auxiliary controller for a simple pneumatic brake release sound (no air simulation, unlike pneumatics/airbrakes). Monitors electrics.values[electricsBrakeName]; if the brake is released by more than 0.2 per second over a 0.25 s window, plays a "pssht" whose intensity depends on the release speed, then waits for a cooldown.
notes: jbeam keys read: soundNode_nodes (first element = sound node, 0 otherwise), soundEvent ("event:>Vehicle>Pneumatics>Air_Brakes"), soundCoolDown (0.5 s), electricsBrakeName ("brake").
The intensity passed to the sound is -dBrake x 0.25 (not capped, unlike pneumatics/airbrakes which caps at 0.99).

init.desc: Reads the jbeam configuration and resets the state to zero.

reset.desc: Resets the sampling state to zero.

updateGFX.desc: Every frame: detects a quick brake release and plays the sound.
